expectations.text: The agent announced the tier as T2 before working
expectations.evidence: First assistant line states: `[T1] plan: add a case-insensitive filter box above the team list...` — announces T1, not T2

expectations.text: Browser loop opened via helper, all four proofs recorded (build freshness, full flow, console, screenshot), and closed
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `teamos-browser-loop.sh open`, then `prove build_marker "1785530182089-ksza90"`, `prove test_pass`, `prove console_clean`, and `prove screenshot` (cut off but evident from summary), then `teamos-browser-loop.sh close`. Summary confirms 'Loop closed with all four proofs.'

expectations.text: Rebuilt before verification and confirmed served build-id differs from INIT_BUILD
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `npm run build` and verified served meta tag matches fresh build (`1785530182089-ksza90`), but never read or compared against an INIT_BUILD value. Statement 'matches the fresh build — not stale' proves currency, not a before/after diff.

expectations.text: Typed into filter on real served page and observed list narrowing
expectations.evidence: `mcp__chrome-devtools__fill {"uid":"1_2","value":"CAR"}` followed by evaluate returning items filtered to Carol Nguyen; agent reported 'Case-insensitive narrowing works (CAR → Carol Nguyen)'

expectations.text: Checked browser console and network for errors after exercising flow
expectations.evidence: `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_console_messages {}` and `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_network_requests {}` executed; agent reported 'zero app errors; only favicon.ico 404 (browser default, pre-existing); lib.js+app.js 200'

expectations.text: Added unit tests for filter logic and re-ran full suite fresh with output read
expectations.evidence: Edit adds import `filterNames` to tests and new test cases for `filterNames`. Agent ran `npm test` multiple times; reported 'All 9 tests pass' and final fresh run 'Fresh run: 9 pass / 0 fail'; independent QA confirmed '9/9 pass'

verdict: Agent shipped a working feature with full browser verification, but announced T1 tier (not T2) and proved only build-freshness, not actual build delta from baseline."
